title: Update a member's contact details
description: Sign on, open a member record, update e-mail, phone and address, and save.
goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE using the Operator ID, Password and Branch supplied. From the main menu choose Member Inquiry / Selection, set 'Search by' to Member Number, enter the member number and press Search. On the MEMBER RECORD screen use the Update Member Information action. Set the e-mail, phone and address to the supplied values, save the change, and read the confirmation message.

outputs.name: confirmation_message
outputs.description: What the console says once the update is saved.
